runtime: Python 3.13, Starlette/Uvicorn WebSocket server, SQLite or PostgreSQL; one process with an independent observer
secret_inputs: Runtime files for initial admin bootstrap, optional client/provider credentials and PostgreSQL URL; app-owned encrypted UI overrides and a mode-0600 runtime key. No Terraform secret values.
state_contract: Version 2 SQL schema with transactional migrations, durable completion/session/user/configuration/audit records; encrypted integration credentials use the separate persistent runtime key.
activation: Local-first; Apollo image digest is opt-in, with controls disabled when observing its existing controller
